Trigger An undead creature within your reach critically fails a Strike against you.

You knock the enemy's blow aside and twist, unbalancing your foe. You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.avant.actionsavant.Item.Disarm], @UUID[Compendium.avant.actionsavant.Item.Shove], or @UUID[Compendium.avant.actionsavant.Item.Trip] the triggering creature.
